text: I'm having a great day!
Finally finished my project, feeling proud
Hung out with friends, it was nice
Not much going on today
Just made some tea and chilling
My exams are stressing me out
I have a presentation tomorrow and I'm nervous
Work has been a lot this week
So many deadlines, I'm overwhelmed
My roommate keeps eating my food and I'm annoyed
I feel completely hopeless
I can't do this anymore, everything is too much
Nobody would even notice if I disappeared
I'm so tired of everything
I've had three panic attacks this week
I feel empty all the time
I hate myself so much
I haven't slept or eaten properly in days
I'm a burden to everyone around me
I'm so angry I want to break something
I want to kill myself
I don't want to be alive anymore
I've been thinking about ending my life
Everyone would be better off without me
I've been cutting myself again
I have the pills ready
Tonight is the night I end it
I wrote a goodbye note
There's no reason for me to live
I just want it all to stop forever
